<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bucket(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>=60 and n['color'] in ('p','W'):
            bb = n['boundary']
            rmin=min(p[0] for p in bb); rmax=max(p[0] for p in bb)
            cmin=min(p[1] for p in bb); cmax=max(p[1] for p in bb)
            if rmin<=31 and rmax<=40 and cmin>=10 and cmax<=50 and (rmax-rmin)>=5:
                return (n['color'],n['pixels'],rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax)
    return None
print("start", bucket(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("R1", bucket(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("R2", bucket(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("R3", bucket(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def bucket(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>=60 and n['color'] in ('p','W'):
            bb = n['boundary']
            rmin=min(p[0] for p in bb); rmax=max(p[0] for p in bb)
            cmin=min(p[1] for p in bb); cmax=max(p[1] for p in bb)
            if rmin<=31 and rmax<=40 and cmin>=10 and cmax<=50 and (rmax-rmin)>=5:
                return (n['color'],n['pixels'],rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax)
    return None
